item.title: "Expand" vs "Protect"... Seok-Cheong Conflict Escalates into Factional Struggle (“넓히자” vs “지키자”… 석청 갈등, 노선투쟁 번졌다)
item.description:
"Expand" vs "Protect"... Seok-Cheong Conflict Escalates into Factional Struggle (“넓히자” vs “지키자”… 석청 갈등, 노선투쟁 번졌다)

The "Seok-Cheong (Kim Min-seok and Chung Cheong-rae) conflict," which flared up again at the Democratic Party of Korea lawmakers' workshop, is spreading into an intraparty factional struggle. Representative Kim argues for a "structural majority" through expanding the party's reach to centrist and conservative voters, a path championed by President Lee Jae-myung, while those opposing this advocate a "base consolidation" strategy aimed at rallying progressive non-partisan voters. Representative Kim said, "We will continue to hold transparent debates on party lines in broad daylight." However, within the party, some have remarked, "Approval ratings are falling—why engage in outdated factional struggles now?" (더불어민주당 국회의원 워크숍에서 다시 불거진 ‘석청(김민석·정청래) 갈등’이 당내 노선 투쟁으로 번지고 있다. 김 대표는 이재명 대통령이 주도해 온 중도·보수 외연 확장을 통한 ‘구조적 다수론’을, 이를 반대하는 쪽은 진보 무당층을 끌어내는 ‘지지층 결집론’을 주장한다. 김 대표는 “앞으로도 백주대낮에 투명하게 노선 논쟁을 할 것”이라고 했다. 다만 당내에선 “지지율도 떨어지고 있는데 철 지난 노선 투쟁을 왜 하냐”는 말도 나왔다.)

At the party workshop on the 27th, Representative Kim argued in his lecture that both he and President Lee believe expansion toward centrist and conservative voters is necessary, and that the party must achieve a "structural majority" to secure consecutive terms in power. He added, "Former Representative Chung is a leading proponent of the 'there is no center' view," and "I have concluded that it is difficult to reach a compromise (with him)." In response, former Representative Chung pushed back, calling the mention of his name "rude and a violent act of microphone dictatorship." (김 대표는 지난 27일 민주당 워크숍 강연에서 이 대통령과 자신은 중도·보수로의 확장이 필요하다는 입장이라며 ‘구조적 다수’로 연속 집권을 해야 한다는 주장을 펼쳤다. 그러면서 “정 전 대표는 대표적인 ‘중도는 없다’론자”라며 “(정 전 대표와) 절충하기 어렵다는 결론을 내렸다”고 했다. 이에 정 전 대표는 “실명을 언급한 건 무례하고 폭력적인 마이크 독재”라며 반발했다.)

Since then, various opinions have emerged within the Democratic Party over the direction the party should take. Pro-Chung Supreme Council member Choi Min-hee said at a party meeting on the 28th, "I agree with centrist expansion," while adding, "I believe there will be no disagreement on solidifying the party's core." Third-term lawmaker Jin Sung-joon wrote on Facebook the same day, "We need to pay attention to voters who abstained because life is too hard," and "We must break free from the habitual thinking that we win only by capturing the center or fighting in the middle ground. To become a structural majority, we must turn abstainers into participants and supporters." This stance differs from the centrist expansion advocated by the President and Representative Kim. It echoes Yoo Si-min's argument that "supporters want an 'extension,' but President Lee is trying to 'rebuild' without the residents' consent." Pro-government YouTuber Kim Ou-joon has also emphasized the "core support base." (이후 민주당에선 당이 가야 할 노선 문제를 두고 각종 의견이 나오고 있다. 친청계 최민희 최고위원은 28일 당 회의에서 “중도 확장에 동의한다”면서도 “민주당 중심을 단단히 하자는 데 이견이 없을 것이라고 생각한다”고 했다. 3선 진성준 의원은 이날 페이스북에서 “먹고살기 힘들어서 기권해 버린 유권자에게 관심을 기울여야 한다”며 “중도만을 잡아야 이긴다거나 중원에서 싸워야 한다는 관성적인 사고에서 벗어나야 한다. 구조적 다수가 되기 위해서는 기권층을 참여층·지지층으로 만들어야 한다”고 했다. 대통령과 김 대표의 중도 확장과는 다른 주장인 셈이다. 이는 “지지자들은 ‘증축’을 원하는데 이 대통령은 입주자 동의 없이 ‘재건축’을 하려 한다”는 취지의 유시민씨 주장과 비슷한 얘기다. 또 친여 유튜버 김어준씨 역시 ‘코어 지지층’을 강조했었다.)

A second-term Democratic Party lawmaker said, "Courting centrists is only possible when our support base is tightly united," adding, "This is not the time for such talk when the President's approval rating has dropped to the 30-40% range. Looking at various polls, isn't our support base also slipping away?" Lawmaker Park Ji-won also noted, "The 2030 generation demands fairness and justice in daily life, not Stone Age factional struggles." (민주당 재선 의원은 “중도층 챙기기는 우리 지지층이 똘똘 뭉쳐 있을 때 가능한 일”이라며 “지금처럼 대통령 지지율이 30~40%대까지 떨어질 때 나올 얘기는 아니다. 각종 여론조사를 보면 우리 지지층도 빠지는 추세 아니냐”고 했다. 박지원 의원은 “2030세대는 구석기 시대 노선 투쟁이 아닌 일상에서의 공정과 정의를 요구한다”고도 했다.)

However, Representative Kim and a significant number of pro-Lee lawmakers are known to sympathize with the structural majority theory. In a post on X (formerly Twitter) the same day, Representative Kim wrote, "Policy debates and debates over party lines are desirable," and "What is truly problematic is what's done behind closed doors, personal attacks, fabricated falsehoods, and demonization." He further stated, "Politics is a continuous process of proposing a line, being chosen, implementing it, and being evaluated," signaling his intent to engage in the factional struggle. He also took aim at former Representative Chung's displeasure over the mention of his name, saying, "Meetings are even broadcast live—why wouldn't we have an open debate naming names?" (하지만 김 대표는 물론 상당수 친명 의원들은 구조적 다수론에 공감하고 있는 것으로 알려졌다. 김 대표는 이날 X(엑스) 글에서 “정책 논쟁과 노선 논쟁은 바람직한 것”이라며 “없는 것, 뒤에서 하는 것, 인신공격과 허위 조작, 악마화가 진짜 문제”라고 했다. 그러면서 “정치는 노선을 제기하고 선택받고 실행하고 평가받는 일의 연속”이라며 노선 투쟁에 나서겠다는 뜻을 밝혔다. 또한 자신의 실명 언급에 불쾌해한 정 전 대표를 겨냥해 “회의도 생중계하는데 왜 실명 공개 논쟁을 안 하겠나”고도 했다.)

The aftershocks of the Seok-Cheong conflict continued. Pro-Chung Supreme Council member Han Min-soo said, "There may be multiple paths toward winning the 2028 general election and the 2030 presidential election," adding, "Constructive discussion and a respectful attitude toward opponents must be a prerequisite in that process." He also remarked, "What we must guard against on the journey is arrogance and self-righteousness." This was interpreted as a jab at Representative Kim's remarks the previous day. A party official said, "Do you think the lingering resentments from the party convention will disappear overnight?" (석청 갈등의 여진도 이어졌다. 친청계 한민수 최고위원은 “2028년 총선 승리와 2030년 대선 승리를 향한 길은 여러 갈래가 있을 수 있다”며 “그 과정에서 건설적인 토론과 상대를 존중하는 태도가 전제돼야 한다”고 했다. 그는 “길을 찾아가는 과정에서 우리가 경계해야 하는 것은 오만과 독선”이라고도 했다. 김 대표의 전날 발언을 겨냥한 것으로 해석됐다. 당 관계자는 “전당대회 때 앙금이 하루아침에 사라지겠나”라고 했다.)

Meanwhile, Democratic Party members of the National Assembly's Legislation and Judiciary Committee, led by committee chairman Seo Young-kyo, held a press conference after the workshop the same day and announced, "We have decided to launch a special counsel investigation into the 'fabricated indictment,' and the timing will be determined through consultation with party leadership." The Democratic Party has claimed that cases involving President Lee Jae-myung constitute a "fabricated indictment" by the prosecution. Early this year, the party pushed for a special counsel to uncover the truth but delayed discussions as public opinion turned negative. Unlike the committee members who formalized the push for the fabricated indictment special counsel that day, cautionary voices remain within the Democratic Party. (이런 가운데 서영교 국회 법제사법위원장을 비록한 민주당 소속 법사위원들이 이날 워크숍 후 기자회견을 열고 “조작 기소 특검을 출범시키기로 했고, 시기는 당 지도부가 협의해 정하기로 했다”고 밝혔다. 민주당은 이재명 대통령 관련 사건이 검찰의 ‘조작 기소’라고 주장해왔다. 올초부턴 이를 밝히기 위한 특검을 추진하다가 여론이 악화되자 논의를 미뤄왔다. 이날 조작 기소 특검 추진을 공식화한 법사위원들과 달리 민주당 내에선 여전히 신중론도 나오고 있다.)

According to a Gallup Korea poll released the same day, President Lee's approval rating fell 3 percentage points (p) from the previous week to 42%, the lowest since his inauguration based on the same survey. Conversely, his disapproval rating rose 5%p to 50%, marking the first time it has entered the 50% range. Among reasons for the negative assessment of President Lee, 'real estate policy' topped the list at 27%, followed by 'reduction of prosecutorial powers,' 'economy and livelihoods,' and 'moral issues and avoidance of his own trial,' each at 7%. The Democratic Party's approval rating fell 2%p from the previous week to 39%, while the People Power Party remained unchanged at 25%. (이날 한국갤럽이 발표한 이 대통령 지지율은 전주보다 3%포인트(p) 하락한 42%로, 같은 조사 기준으로 취임 후 최저치였다. 반면 부정 평가는 전주보다 5%p 상승한 50%로 첫 50%대였다. 이 대통령 부정 평가 이유에선 ‘부동산 정책’이 27%로 가장 높았고 ‘검찰 권한 축소’ ‘경제·민생’ ‘도덕성 문제·본인 재판 회피’가 각각 7%였다. 민주당 지지율은 전주보다 2%p 하락한 39%, 국민의힘은 전주와 같은 25%였다.)

item.title: 100 Million Won for Marriage, 10 Million Won for Having a Baby (결혼하면 100만원, 애 낳으면 1000만원 준다)
item.description:
100 Million Won for Marriage, 10 Million Won for Having a Baby (결혼하면 100만원, 애 낳으면 1000만원 준다)

President Lee Jae-myung presided over the "Youth Budget Unboxing 2027" event at the presidential office on the 28th and said, "I too am unable to escape being an old-timer, and I reflect on that." At the event, held to introduce youth support policies set to take effect next year, President Lee said, "We all need to look back on whether government policies have truly started from the needs of young people, and whether we have designed policies not according to the needs of us, the consumers, but perhaps according to the convenience of the suppliers, the government, and we need to boldly fix what needs to be fixed." <<> Many young officials and senior officials tasked with presenting the budget attended the event that day. In front of them, President Lee said, "'Suffering when young is worth buying' and 'failure is the mother of success' are outdated sayings—these days, saying such things is likely to get you slapped in the face. Amid the anxiety that once you fall, you may never get back up and could end up drowning in debt, failure is perceived not as the mother of success but as a 'fast track to ruin.'" <<> That day, the government announced it would invest a total of 43.3 trillion won next year across growth stages for young people, including jobs and startups, education, housing and assets, and daily life and culture. This is a 53.5% increase from this year's 28.2 trillion won. The plan is to train and nurture 300,000 young workers by 2030, focusing on advanced industries such as artificial intelligence (AI), semiconductors, and the green transition (GX) sector. Couples who complete their marriage registration will receive 1 million won once in their lifetime as a "marriage support grant." For the first child born on or after July 1 next year, a cash payment of 1 million won will be provided. The income requirements for the youth monthly rent support program will also be eased to expand the scope of beneficiaries. <<> President Lee's remarks that day came amid a sharp decline in approval ratings among young people. According to a Korea Gallup survey conducted from the 25th to the 27th, President Lee's job performance approval rating was 42%, but approval among those in their 20s (31%) and 30s (35%) was notably lower compared to other age groups. <<> As soon as President Lee entered the event venue, which featured a backdrop reading "From Youth's Potential to Greater Opportunities," he looked around at the senior presidential secretaries and said, "The atmosphere today is very young and full of vitality, which is great. Our presenters are all young officials and senior officials—it seems we need to change up the composition of the presidential office as well. Our chief of policy and chief of staff must be feeling nervous, right?" he joked. He added, "Even I, saying this, often feel when talking with the younger generation, 'No matter how hard I try, I can't escape being an old-timer,' and I am constantly reflecting and making an effort." <<> At the event, measures to reduce the burden of high housing costs and help young people build assets were introduced. These include raising the income requirement for the youth monthly rent support program, which provides up to 200,000 won per month in rent assistance, from 60% of median income to 100%, and extending the support period from a maximum of 24 months to 48 months. Under this change, the income threshold for a single-person working household would ease by 25%, from 2.19 million won to 2.73 million won. The eligibility requirements for the Youth Housing Dream subscription savings account, used for apartment lotteries, would also be relaxed from an annual income of 50 million won to 70 million won. (이재명 대통령이 28일 청와대에서 ‘청년 예산 언박싱 2027’ 행사를 주재하며 “나도 역시 꼰대를 못 벗어나 반성한다”고 말했다. 내년부터 시행되는 청년 지원 정책 소개를 위해 열린 이날 행사에서 이 대통령은 “그동안 정부 정책이 과연 청년들의 필요에서 출발했는지, 또 정책을 우리 수요자의 필요가 아니라 혹시 공급자, 정부의 편의대로 설계해온 건 아닌지 우리 모두가 되돌아보고 또 과감하게 고칠 것은 고쳐 나가야 되겠다”고 했다.)

item.title: Gwangju Military Airfield Candidate Site... Muan Selected as Final Location (광주軍공항 후보지… 무안으로 최종 선정)
item.description:
Gwangju Military Airfield Candidate Site... Muan Selected as Final Location (광주軍공항 후보지… 무안으로 최종 선정)

The Ministry of National Defense finalized the area around Mangun-myeon, Muan-gun, South Jeolla Province, as the candidate site for relocating the Gwangju military airfield on the 28th. The ministry had designated this area as a preliminary candidate in April and confirmed it as an official candidate just four months later. The government appears to be accelerating the relocation process after deciding last month to build a Honam semiconductor cluster on the Gwangju military airfield site. (국방부가 28일 광주 군공항 이전 후보지로 전남광주 무안군 망운면 일대를 최종 선정했다. 국방부는 지난 4월 이 지역을 예비 후보지로 지정한 데 이어 4개월 만에 정식 후보지로 확정했다. 정부가 지난달 광주 군공항 부지에 호남권 반도체 클러스터를 건설하기로 한 이후 이전 작업에 속도를 내는 모양새다.)

At a "Gwangju Military Airfield Relocation Site Selection Committee" meeting held that day at the ministry building in Yongsan-gu, Seoul, attended by Defense Minister Ahn Kyu-baek, Gwangju Mayor Min Hyeong-bae, and Muan County Governor Kim San, the ministry announced its decision, stating, "After reviewing Air Force operational requirements and matters requiring permits under relevant laws, it was confirmed that there are no insurmountable obstacles at this stage [to relocating to Muan]." The ministry plans to build a new military runway in the nearby coastal area rather than using the existing runway of Muan International Airport. The government aims to complete the Muan military airfield by 2032. (국방부는 이날 서울 용산구 국방부 청사에서 안규백 국방부 장관, 민형배 전남광주시장, 김산 무안군수 등이 참석한 가운데 ‘광주 군공항 이전 부지 선정위원회’를 열고 “공군 작전성과 관련 법령상 인허가가 필요한 사항을 검토한 결과, 현 단계에서 (무안 이전에) 불가 항목이 없는 것으로 확인됐다”며 무안군을 후보로 결정했다고 발표했다. 국방부는 현재 무안국제공항 활주로를 이용하지 않고 인근 해안 지역에 새 군용 활주로를 건설할 계획이다. 정부는 2032년까지 무안 군공항을 완성한다는 계획이다.)

Accordingly, the Gwangju military airfield relocation project is expected to gain momentum. The government will form a support committee for the relocation project, chaired by the Deputy Prime Minister for Economic Affairs and Minister of Strategy and Finance, to review support measures for the Muan region. This will include establishing plans to compensate residents for property rights infringement and noise damage caused by the military airfield. (이에 따라 광주 군공항 이전 사업도 속도를 낼 전망이다. 정부는 국무조정실장을 위원장으로 하는 이전 사업 지원위원회를 꾸려 무안 지역에 대한 지원을 검토하게 된다. 군공항이 들어서 발생하는 주민 재산권 침해와 소음 피해 등 피해 보전 계획이 수립되는 것이다.)

However, for the military airfield to be finally relocated, the Muan County Governor must apply for hosting it, following a resident vote in Muan-gun. The government plans to complete the process within this year. Minister Ahn said, "This is a historic step forward not only in resolving a regional issue that has persisted for decades but also in achieving balanced regional development." (다만 군공항이 최종 이전하려면 무안군 주민투표를 거쳐 무안군수가 유치 신청을 해야 한다. 정부는 연내 절차를 마무리한다는 계획이다. 안규백 장관은 “수십 년간 이어져 온 지역 현안 해결은 물론 지역 균형 발전을 위한 역사적 진전”이라고 했다.)

◇'Semiconductor Fab Delays Feared' – Military Airfield Relocation, Adrift for Over a Decade, Picks Up Pace (◇‘반도체 팹 늦어질라’ 10년 넘게 표류하던 군공항 이전 급물살)

The area around Mangun-myeon, Muan-gun, selected as the candidate site for the Gwangju military airfield relocation, was previously designated as a 'preliminary relocation candidate site' in April. This area is a coastal region approximately 1–2 kilometers from the runway of Muan International Airport, which is currently used by civilians. (광주 군공항 이전 후보지로 선정된 무안군 망운면 일대는 앞서 지난 4월 광주 군공항 이전을 위한 ‘예비 이전 후보지’로 선정된 곳이다. 이곳은 현재 민간이 이용 중인 무안국제공항 활주로에서 1~2㎞가량 떨어진 해안 지역이다.)

The Gwangju military airfield relocation project began in 2014 when Gwangju Metropolitan City proposed the relocation to the Ministry of National Defense. The project drifted for a long time without selecting a relocation site, until December last year when a consultative body involving Gwangju City, South Jeolla Province, and Muan-gun was formed, agreeing to relocate to Muan. However, Muan-gun boycotted the site selection committee meetings in June and July, demanding the priority relocation of Gwangju Airport, a civilian airport, to Muan International Airport, guarantees of 1 trillion won in support, and groundbreaking national-level incentives. (광주군공항 이전 사업은 2014년 광주광역시가 국방부에 군공항 이전을 건의하며 시작됐다. 이후 이전 부지를 정하지 못해 장기간 표류하다 작년 12월에 광주시·전남도·무안군 등이 참여한 협의체를 구성해 무안 이전을 합의했다. 하지만 무안군이 민간 공항인 광주공항의 무안국제공항 우선 이전, 1조원 규모의 지원 보장, 국가 차원의 획기적인 인센티브 등을 요구하며 6·7월 부지 선정위원회에 불참했다.)

At a Cabinet meeting on the 4th, President Lee Jae-myung, regarding the Gwangju military airfield relocation, said, "If implementing national policy benefits the region, we should cooperate—what's this about saying, 'If you don't do this, I won't cooperate'?" He added, "There are those who oppose and those who obstruct, but I believe it's important to join forces and get the necessary things done where possible." The following day, Muan-gun returned to the site selection committee, stating, "We will continue discussions with a responsible attitude." (이재명 대통령은 지난 4일 국무회의에서 광주 군공항 이전과 관련해 “국가 정책 시행이 해당 지역에 도움이 되면 협력해야지 ‘이거 안 해주면 난 협조 못 한다’고 하는 게 뭐냐”며 “반대하는 쪽도 있고, 방해하는 쪽도 있지만 가능하면 힘을 모아 필요한 일들을 해내는 게 중요하겠다는 생각이 든다”고 했다. 그러자 다음 날 무안군은 “책임 있는 자세로 협의를 이어가겠다”며 부지 선정위원회에 복귀했다.)

Observers point out that President Lee's call for the swift implementation of the military airfield relocation to Muan is linked to the government's designation of the Gwangju military airfield site for the Honam semiconductor cluster. Concerns that delays in the military airfield relocation would correspondingly postpone semiconductor cluster construction spurred the accelerated selection of the Muan candidate site. On the 14th, the Ministry of National Defense announced plans to temporarily disperse the Air Force's 1st Fighter Wing, currently stationed at Gwangju military airfield, to airbases such as Yecheon and Seosan by 2028, before the final relocation to Muan by 2032. (이 대통령이 군공항 무안 이전의 조속 이행을 요구한 것은 정부가 호남권 반도체 클러스터 입지를 광주 군공항 부지로 지정한 것과 연관돼 있다는 지적이 나온다. 군공항 이전이 늦어지면 반도체 클러스터 건설도 그만큼 미뤄진다는 우려 때문에 무안 지역의 후보지 선정에 박차를 가했다는 것이다. 국방부는 지난 14일 광주 군공항을 2032년까지 무안으로 최종 이전하기 전에 광주군공항에 주둔 중인 공군 제1전투비행단을 2028년까지 예천·서산 군공항 등에 임시 분산 배치하겠다는 계획을 밝혔다.)

For the Muan region to be confirmed as the final relocation site, several steps remain: specifying support measures for the relocation area, conducting a resident vote, submitting a hosting application, and having the Ministry of National Defense make the final site determination. The ministry and Gwangju Metropolitan City will carry out procedures such as public hearings for this purpose, followed by the resident vote. The Muan County Governor will decide whether to apply for hosting, taking into account the level of support or opposition among residents. (무안 지역이 최종 이전지로 확정되려면, 이전 지역 지원 방안을 구체화하고 주민투표와 유치 신청을 거친 뒤 국방부가 최종 부지를 결정하는 단계가 남아있다. 국방부와 전남광주시는 이를 위해 공청회 등 절차를 거칠 예정이다. 이후 주민투표 절차가 이어진다. 주민의 어느 정도가 찬성 또는 반대하는지를 참고해 무안군수가 유치 신청 여부를 결정하게 된다.)

Once the hosting application is received, the Ministry of National Defense will reconvene the relocation site selection committee to finalize the area around Mangun-myeon, Muan-gun, as the final relocation site. The government and Gwangju Metropolitan City are pushing the project with the goal of confirming the relocation site within this year. (유치 신청이 접수되면 국방부는 다시 이전 부지 선정위원회를 열어 무안군 망운면 일대를 최종 이전 부지로 확정하는 절차를 밟게 된다. 정부와 전남광주시는 연내 이전 부지 확정을 목표로 사업을 추진하고 있다.)

item.title: Audit Office TF Called It 'Yoon Administration's Coercive Investigation'... But the Recording Says 'Do It Voluntarily' (감사원 TF는 ‘尹정부의 강압 조사’라 했는데… 녹취록엔 “자발적으로 하세요”)
item.description:
Audit Office TF Called It 'Yoon Administration's Coercive Investigation'... But the Recording Says 'Do It Voluntarily' (감사원 TF는 ‘尹정부의 강압 조사’라 했는데… 녹취록엔 “자발적으로 하세요”)

On the 28th, a day after the Audit Office released findings that there had been coercive investigations and widespread illegal forensic extraction of mobile phones during the 'audit of alleged statistics manipulation under the Moon Jae-in administration', the auditors targeted for severe disciplinary action pushed back, saying the findings did not match what actually happened, and released parts of the recordings. These auditors argued that there had been no claims of 'coercive investigation' for nearly two years after the interim audit results were announced in September 2023, but that the TF had accepted at face value the claims of some auditees that changed after the current administration took office. (감사원이 ‘문재인 정부 통계 조작 의혹 감사’ 과정에서 강압 조사와 광범위한 휴대전화 불법 포렌식 등이 있었다는 조사 결과를 발표한 지 하루 만인 28일, 중징계 대상으로 지목된 감사관들이 발표 내용이 당시 상황과 다르다고 반박하며 녹취 일부를 공개했다. 이 감사관들은 2023년 9월 감사 중간 결과 발표 이후 2년 가까이 ‘강압 조사’ 주장이 없었는데, 현 정부 출범 후 달라진 일부 피감사자의 주장을 TF가 그대로 받아들였다고 반발하고 있다.)

The Audit Office TF, which has been investigating the statistics manipulation audit team, announced on the 27th that when auditors B and C questioned Secretary A of the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport, they "forced consent to mobile phone forensic extraction by saying 'you need to cooperate if you want to avoid problems with your personal record'" and that they would dismiss them. The TF stated, "When consent was refused, Auditor C pressured Secretary A by saying 'it would be in your interest to consent' and 'there's an empty room next door, go there and think about it,' leading Secretary A to reluctantly indicate he would consent." (통계 조작 감사팀을 조사해 온 감사원 TF는 지난 27일 감사팀의 B·C 감사관이 국토부 A 서기관을 조사했을 당시 “‘신상 문제가 없으려면 협조해야 한다’며 휴대전화 포렌식 동의를 강요했다”면서 이들을 파면하겠다고 밝혔다. 감사원 TF는 “동의를 거절하자 C 감사관은 ‘동의하는 것이 본인에게 좋을 것이다’라는 취지로 이야기하며 ‘옆에 빈방이 있는데 거기 가서 생각을 해봐라’라고 A 서기관을 압박해, A 서기관이 어쩔 수 없이 동의하겠다는 의사를 표시했다”고 했다.)

Auditor C released to the press the conversation with Secretary A that had been recorded during the investigation. The released recording contained no remarks about 'personal record issues.' In it, Auditor C told Secretary A, "It's your choice, so do it voluntarily (regarding consent to forensic extraction)." He then added, "If you cooperate, it would probably be good for both you and us, so I'm just recommending it, and you can decide whether to do it or not..." before saying to another auditor, "Could you escort (Secretary A) to the next room?" Auditor B then added, "He said he wanted some time to review it before submitting his phone, but since we don't have the equipment and it's complicated, we asked him to decide within today..." (C 감사관은 조사 당시 녹음해 둔 A 서기관과의 대화를 언론에 공개했다. 공개된 녹취에 ‘신상 문제’ 등의 발언은 없었다. C 감사관은 A 서기관에게 “본인이 선택하시는 거니까, 그것(포렌식 동의)은 자발적으로 하세요”라고 말했다. 이어 “협조를 해주시면 아마 본인한테도 좋고 우리한테도 좋을 것 같아서 일단 권유를 하는 거고, 그거에 대해 이제 본인이 선택해서 주실지 아닐지를 한번…”이라며 다른 감사관에게 “(A 서기관을) 옆방에 한번 안내해 주실 수 있나요?”라고 했다. 그러자 B 감사관은 “휴대폰 제출하기 전에 본인이 검토하고 싶다고 해서 시간을 좀 달라고 하셨는데, 또 시간 되면 우리 (포렌식) 장비도 없고 막 복잡해서 오늘 중으로 판단하시라고…” 부연했다.)

In April, the Audit Office asked agencies that had undergone audits into the alleged statistics manipulation to submit cases of 'coercive investigation.' Among them, only the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport—which is suspected of pressuring the Korea Real Estate Board to manipulate statistics—submitted statements claiming such coercion had occurred. Meanwhile, investigations into civil servants' mobile phones were also common under previous administrations. The Blue House under the Moon administration conducted forensic extraction on foreign ministry employees' phones multiple times to find leakers related to media reports on diplomatic affairs. Phones of employees at the Ministry of Health and Welfare and the Presidential Security Service were also subject to 'security investigations.' (감사원은 지난 4월 통계 조작 의혹 감사를 받았던 기관들에 ‘강압 조사’ 피해 사례를 모아달라고 했다. 그중 부동산원을 압박해 통계를 조작하게 한 혐의를 받은 국토부에서만 강압 조사가 있었다는 의견서들이 나왔다. 한편, 공무원 휴대전화에 대한 조사는 과거 정부에서도 자주 이뤄졌다. 문재인 정부 청와대는 외교 사안에 대한 언론 보도와 관련해 유출자를 찾는다며 외교부 직원들의 휴대전화를 여러 차례 포렌식했다. 보건복지부와 대통령경호처 직원들의 휴대전화도 ‘보안 조사’ 대상이 됐었다.)

item.title: Lee Rejects Supreme Court Justice Nominee, Requests Renomination (李, 대법관 후보 임명 거부… 재제청 요구)
item.description:
Lee Rejects Supreme Court Justice Nominee, Requests Renomination (李, 대법관 후보 임명 거부… 재제청 요구)

The presidential office announced on the 28th that President Lee Jae-myung decided not to submit a nomination consent request to the National Assembly for Judge Son Bong-gi of the Daegu District Court, whom Chief Justice Cho Hee-dae had nominated as a replacement for former Justice Noh Tae-ak, and requested the re-nomination of a Supreme Court justice candidate. This marks the first time under the current Constitution, revised in 1987, that a president has rejected a chief justice's nomination for a Supreme Court justice. Chief Justice Cho said on his way home that day, "I apologize for causing concern to the public," adding, "We are currently reviewing the details, so I will share more next week." <<> Kang Yu-jung, the senior presidential spokesperson for the presidential office, said that day, "The nomination for the successor to former Justice Noh lacked sufficient procedural completeness," and "The Chief Justice unilaterally submitted a written nomination for Judge Son on the 18th without any substantive consultation." The presidential office did submit a nomination consent request to the National Assembly that day for Judge Kim Sung-soo of the Seoul High Court, whom Chief Justice Cho had nominated to replace Justice Lee Heung-gu. This means only Judge Kim, whose nomination was agreed upon through prior consultation, will proceed with the appointment process. <<> The presidential office maintains that Chief Justice Cho broke with convention by unilaterally notifying without prior consultation with the president, and that this is unacceptable. The Democratic Party also called for Chief Justice Cho's voluntary resignation, calling it "an unprecedented constitutional crisis." Regarding the nomination authority granted to the Chief Justice under the Constitution, the presidential office stated, "The Chief Justice's nomination authority is not a conclusive power, but must be exercised in a way that respects the substantive appointment authority the Constitution grants to the president as the appointing authority." It then urged Chief Justice Cho, "Please respect the recommendations of the Supreme Court Justice Candidate Recommendation Committee and proceed with the re-nomination process as swiftly as possible." In legal circles, there was speculation that "this is effectively a request to recommend Judge Kim Min-ki of the Seoul High Court, whom the president is known to want appointed." Judge Kim is a member of Uri Beop Yeonguhoe (Our Law Research Society), a progressive-leaning judges' organization. <<> The opposition said, "President Lee is trampling the Constitution and shaking the foundations of the separation of powers to take control of the judiciary." People Power Party floor leader Chung Jeom-sik said, "This is the opening salvo of a campaign to bring the judiciary to heel, so that President Lee can appoint all 22 Supreme Court justices during his term at will," adding, "The judiciary should not yield and should re-nominate Judge Son." <<> ◇Direct clash between Supreme Court justice appointment and nomination powers... separation of powers is shaken <<> As President Lee Jae-myung rejected Chief Justice Cho Hee-dae's nomination of a Supreme Court justice candidate that day, controversy over unconstitutionality erupted in political and legal circles. Article 104(2) of the Constitution stipulates that "Supreme Court Justices shall be appointed by the President with the consent of the National Assembly, upon the nomination of the Chief Justice." In academia, many view this as granting the nomination power, consent power, and appointment power as equal authorities under the principle of separation of powers. <<> However, the presidential office said that day, "The president is a representative of the people directly elected by the sovereign citizens, and the Chief Justice is an institution appointed by the president with the consent of the National Assembly," adding, "In light of the principle of popular sovereignty, the nomination power should be understood not as a power that replaces or nullifies the appointment power, but as a power that supports the proper exercise of the appointment power." This means the appointment power of the president, an elected authority, takes precedence over the Chief Justice's nomination power. The presidential office stated this was a conclusion reached after reviewing relevant laws and that "the president's appointment power inherently includes substantive discretion in review." <<> When President Lee rejected the nomination of Judge Son Bong-ki of the Daegu District Court that day, political circles reacted, saying, "This is an unprecedented incident where the president has openly interfered with the Chief Justice's constitutional nomination power to appoint someone of his choosing as a Supreme Court justice." It was reported that the presidential office had originally wanted Judge Kim Min-ki of the Seoul High Court, known to be pro-government, to be nominated rather than Judge Son. Judge Kim had overturned a first-instance guilty verdict and acquitted Kim Man-bae, a key figure in the Daejang-dong case for which President Lee was indicted, in an appeals trial last year. <<> Earlier, the Supreme Court Justice Candidate Recommendation Committee had recommended four candidates to Chief Justice Cho in January as successors to former Justice Noh: Judge Son Bong-ki, Judge Yoon Sung-sik of the Seoul High Court, Judge Park Soon-young of the Seoul High Court, and Judge Kim Min-ki of the Seoul High Court. From that point on, rumors circulated inside and outside the courts that the presidential office wanted Judge Kim Min-ki, a member of Uri Beop YeonGuhoe, as the successor, but Chief Justice Cho opposed this, leading to a confrontation between the two sides. <<> Chief Justice Cho was reportedly opposed to nominating Judge Kim, citing the fact that Judge Kim's husband, Oh Young-joon, was appointed as a Constitutional Court justice under the current administration. The argument was that it would be inappropriate for a Constitutional Court justice husband to adjudicate via constitutional complaint the constitutionality of a Supreme Court ruling in which his wife was involved. Most in legal circles also considered it unprecedented for a married couple to serve simultaneously as the nation's highest judges. However, the presidential office and pro-government figures dismissed this, saying, "The logic that a wife cannot become a Supreme Court justice because her husband is a Constitutional Court justice is far-fetched," and called it "a challenge and insubordination by the Chief Justice against the president." <<> Some interpreted the reason the presidential office is insisting on Judge Kim Min-ki and bearing the burden of rejecting the Chief Justice's nomination as "a demonstration of its will to lead the future composition of the Supreme Court." Since the launch of the Lee Jae-myung administration, the Democratic Party pushed through legislation under the name of "judicial reform" to expand the Supreme Court from 14 to 26 justices. Accordingly, President Lee will appoint 22 of the 26 justices during his term. The opposition has argued, "The president is trying to fill the Supreme Court with pro-Lee justices to erase his own trials." <<> The presidential office that day demanded that the Supreme Court proceed with re-nomination as swiftly as possible while respecting the existing recommendations of the Supreme Court Justice Candidate Recommendation Committee. It also said that excluding the individuals recommended by the committee in January from the nomination pool would "undermine trust in the fairness of the personnel process." As the vacancy on the Supreme Court has dragged on, the Court considered receiving new candidates altogether, but the presidential office firmly stated that new candidates should not be accepted and that a nomination should be made from among the existing candidates. <<> A legal figure said, "Among the four candidates recommended by the Supreme Court Justice Candidate Recommendation Committee, Judge Son Bong-ki was rejected by the presidential office, and Judge Yoon Sung-sik is heading the Seoul High Court's division handling insurrection cases, making nomination difficult," adding, "Judge Park Soon-young, who also serves as a member of the National Election Commission, is involved in the recent shortage of ballots in the June 3 local elections, so in effect, the presidential office's demand is essentially to nominate Judge Kim Min-ki." Another figure said, "The Court Organization Act stipulates that a candidate recommendation committee shall be formed when nominating Supreme Court justices," adding, "There could also be disputes over whether re-nominating from the existing pool without forming a new committee is procedurally proper." Regarding the claim that President Lee requested re-nomination with Judge Kim's appointment in mind, a presidential office official said, "That is unconfirmed." <<> In opposition circles, there was criticism that President Lee's request for re-nomination of Supreme Court justices amounted to "declaring the creation of a 'Lee Jae-myung judiciary' tailored to the president's tastes." There were also proposals to file a jurisdiction dispute adjudication with the Constitutional Court to determine whether the president's re-nomination request is unconstitutional. People Power Party senior spokesperson Park Choong-kwon said in a commentary, "This is blatant intimidation of the judiciary," and "Judicial independence and the separation of powers are not objects of bargaining." Huh Young, professor emeritus at Kyung Hee University, said, "The president's rejection of the nomination not only infringes on the Chief Justice's nomination power but also on the National Assembly's consent power." (이재명 대통령은 28일 조희대 대법원장이 노태악 전 대법관의 후임으로 임명 제청한 손봉기 대구지법 부장판사에 대해 국회에 임명 동의안을 제출하지 않기로 하고 대법관 후보자의 재(再)제청을 요청했다고 청와대가 밝혔다. 1987년 개정된 현행 헌법 체계에서 대통령이 대법원장의 대법관 임명 제청을 거부한 건 처음이다. 조 대법원장은 이날 퇴근길에 “국민 여러분께 심려를 끼쳐서 송구하다”며 “자세한 내용은 우리가 검토 중에 있으니까 다음 주 중 말씀드리겠다”고 했다.)

]]>
